docs.title: osdu.ConfigProperty: the central configuration the control plane supplies to the runs it queues
docs.summary: One row per configuration value: the name a flow spells as ${env:NAME}, its value or reference, and the repository and partition it applies to.

docs.title: osdu.Dimension: one dimension of a dimension flow in a partition, its declaration and what it holds now
docs.summary: One row per dimension of a flow in a partition: the declaration its last build read with, the field it asked for, its dim_ table and columns, and its counts.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionAttribute: each value of each attribute of a dimension's keys
docs.summary: One row per key, attribute and value: the value read for the key, where it was read from, and for a collected attribute how many of the key's records hold it.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionAttributeName: each attribute of a dimension, under the number its values are joined by
docs.summary: One row per attribute or element field of a dimension: its number, its name, whether it is collected, and its place among the attributes declared now.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionChange: each change a build made to one key of a dimension
docs.summary: One row per change a build made to a key: it arrived, left, came back, or moved from one value to another, with the values it moved from and to.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionCollectedText: each text a dimension's records hold at a collected attribute's path
docs.summary: One row per collected attribute and text: the text exactly as the index holds it, the value it is shown as, and the records holding it.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionElement: each field of each object of a nested array a dimension's keys hold
docs.summary: One row per field of an object of a nested array a key's records hold (a curve of a well log): the key, the object's place, the field and its value.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionKeyRecord: each record a dimension key's label and attributes were read through
docs.summary: One row per key and record its label and attributes were read through: the record's id hash and entity type, how an incremental load finds keys to read again.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionMember: one value of a dimension, a clean value with its records and search filter
docs.summary: One row per member (clean value) of a dimension: the value, the records holding any of its keys, its search filter, and the builds that found and removed it.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionRecord: the keys each record of a dimension held when a load last read it
docs.summary: One row per record and key it held, the record named by a hash of its unique key (incremental.keyColumns): what an incremental load reads again.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionRun: one build of one dimension, how it read, what it found and what it changed
docs.summary: One row per build of a dimension: how it loaded (full or incremental), how it read the index, what it found and how complete that is, and what it changed.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionStageAttribute: the attribute values a running dimension build read for its keys
docs.summary: One row per attribute value a running dimension build read for a key, through the record it names or collected from its records.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionStageElement: the objects of a nested array a running dimension build read
docs.summary: One row per field of an object of a nested array a running dimension build read, with the record holding the object and its place there.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionStageKey: the keys a running dimension build has read, in the order it read them
docs.summary: One row per key a running dimension build read, with how many records hold it: what the build labels and cleans a batch at a time.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionStageMember: the values a running dimension build laid out from its keys
docs.summary: One row per value a running dimension build laid out from its keys: its records, keys and filter. What the build's write holds of its values.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionStageRecord: the records a running dimension build read through, read, or found holding a key
docs.summary: One row per record a running dimension build met: one a key's label or attributes were read through, one read by its unique key, or a key such a record holds.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionStageText: the texts a running dimension build collected
docs.summary: One row per text a running dimension build collected at a collected attribute's path, with the value it is shown as and the records holding it.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionStageValue: the keys of a running dimension build, as it cleaned them
docs.summary: One row per key a running dimension build cleaned: its value or why it has none, its label, count and filter. What the build's write holds.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionValue: one key of a dimension, exactly as the index holds it, and the value it is under
docs.summary: One row per original (key) of a dimension: the key exactly as the index holds it, its member or why it has none, its label, filter and records.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionView: each view a dimension flow declares, as its builds last wrote it in the schema
docs.summary: One row per view a dimension flow declares: its v_dim_ name, its declaration, the statement it was written with, its tables and columns, and who wrote it.

docs.title: osdu.DimensionViewCheck: what a build's check of a dimension view found in a partition
docs.summary: One row per check of a dimension view in a partition: passed or failed, its rows, what each join found, and what each converted column could not read.

docs.title: osdu.Interface: each interface of a delivery flow as the repository sync found it, and the ledger it keeps
docs.summary: One row per interface of a delivery flow, per partition it names: its pipeline, ledger identity, route, mapping, cache version and record table.

docs.title: osdu.Inventory: one inventory of an inventory flow in a partition, what it reads and its last build and reconcile
docs.summary: One row per inventory a flow declares in a partition: the kind and query it reads, how it reads, the owners its last reconcile used, and its last runs.

docs.title: osdu.InventoryDuplicateCheck: a check of an inventory's ids for duplicate records, by an operator's key
docs.summary: One row per duplicate check of an inventory: what it downloaded and its table, its key, where it stands, what it found, and its last selection.

docs.title: osdu.InventoryDuplicateGroup: each group of an inventory's ids a duplicate check found sharing a key
docs.summary: One row per group of ids a duplicate check found sharing a key: its copies, how it came out and why, the copy it keeps and who chose it.

docs.title: osdu.InventoryDuplicateMember: each copy in a duplicate check's groups, with its values, completeness and role
docs.summary: One row per copy in a duplicate check's groups: its key's hash and values, what storage held of it, how many values it holds, and its role.

docs.title: osdu.InventoryRecord: each id an inventory holds or a ledger expects, and what the ledgers hold of it
docs.summary: One row per OSDU id an inventory holds, or a ledger of its partition expects: its system properties, when it was seen, changed or gone, and its finding.

docs.title: osdu.InventoryRemoval: one removal of an inventory's ids an operator asked for, and what it came to
docs.summary: One row per removal of an inventory's ids: the run, who asked, the finding and scope, how many ids the operator was shown, and its tallies.

docs.title: osdu.InventoryRemovalItem: what one removal did to one id, and why
docs.summary: One row per id an inventory removal reached: the version it found, the finding it had, the outcome (removed, gone, skipped or failed) and why.

docs.title: osdu.InventoryRun: one build or reconcile of an inventory, how it read OSDU and what it found and changed
docs.summary: One row per build or reconcile of an inventory: the run and who asked, how it read OSDU, what the merge changed, and its counts by finding.

docs.title: osdu.InventoryScan: each id a build listed, staged until the read is whole and merged into the inventory
docs.summary: One row per id an inventory build's read listed, with its system properties as OSDU served them, held only until the build merges or fails.

docs.title: osdu.InventorySelection: the ids of an inventory that hold what an operator's conditions ask in OSDU
docs.summary: One row per match of an operator's conditions against an inventory: the conditions as written and as searched, how OSDU was read, and its counts.

docs.title: osdu.InventorySelectionItem: each id of an inventory a match found holding what its conditions ask
docs.summary: One row per id a match of an inventory selection found: the version the search index held, and the values it held at the conditions' properties.

docs.title: osdu.InventoryVersion: each version storage keeps of a record an inventory holds
docs.summary: One row per version storage keeps of a record an inventory holds, for an inventory that reads every version (versions: all).

docs.title: osdu.Lease: a worker's hold on work, one row per claim, renewed while it delivers
docs.summary: One row per worker claim on a work batch or a group of records due for a retry: its token, owner, expiry, and the tries its flow allows.

docs.title: osdu.Ledger: the ledger directory, one row per ledger identity and the partition it belongs to
docs.summary: One row per ledger: the identity every ledger row carries, the partition it belongs to, its kind, flow, interface and display name.

docs.title: osdu.LedgerFlow: each retrieval, assertion, dimension and inventory flow as the repository sync found it
docs.summary: One row per retrieval, assertion, dimension or inventory flow of a repository: its kind, file, document hash, and whether it keeps a ledger per partition.

docs.title: osdu.LedgerPartition: the number each OSDU partition is keyed by in every ledger table
docs.summary: One row per data partition the ledger has rows in: the two-byte number every ledger key starts with, and the partition's name.

docs.title: osdu.Mapping: each mapping document a repository sync found, the read model behind the mappings page
docs.summary: One row per mapping document a repository holds: its reference, the template it fills and the file it was read from, its text, a summary, and whether it loads.

docs.title: osdu.Partition: the partition registry, the OSDU partitions registered with the catalog and the default one
docs.summary: One row per OSDU data partition registered with the catalog: what it is for, whether it is the default, whether the configuration names it, and who changed it.

docs.title: osdu.PurgedRecord: the one line kept of a record deleted from the ledger after its removal from OSDU
docs.summary: One row per record deleted from the ledger: its key, label, OSDU id and last version, who deleted it, and the request to read its row again.

docs.title: osdu.Record: the current state of one deliverable of one flow, and the work waiting to be sent
docs.summary: One row per record a flow delivers: what OSDU holds of it, where it came from, the work queued for it, its status and why it is blocked.

docs.title: osdu.RecordEvent: what a worker appended under its lease and the lease has not applied to the record yet
docs.summary: One row per step a worker completed or try it ended under a lease, with the claimed work it carried; applied to the record once, then deleted.

docs.title: osdu.RecordIdentity: every value a record can be found by, folded to upper case for prefix lookups
docs.summary: One row per value a record is known by (an identity column, a key value, a label word, its OSDU id, its file): what the record search reads.

docs.title: osdu.RemovalKey: the keys a running removal staged from its sources and the delivery flow's record table
docs.summary: Staging for one removal run: each distinct key read from the source's current keys, its removed keys or the record table, derived to its delivery key.

docs.title: osdu.RemovalRun: one run of one removal of a removal flow, what it read, found and took out
docs.summary: One row per run of a removal: the removal flow and removal, the delivery ledger it wrote to, what it read and compared, found removed and took out.

docs.title: osdu.RemovedKey: a delivery ledger's deletions, the keys its source no longer holds, and how far taking each out has come
docs.summary: One row per key a removal flow found its source removed: why and as of when, its state, what taking it out came to, and who found and approved it.
keywords: keys the source no longer holds

docs.title: osdu.RepositoryTemplate: each file of a repository's template folders, as the last sync found it
docs.summary: One row per file in a template folder of a synced repository: the kind and version it holds, or why none. The template is read from the file.

docs.title: osdu.Retrieval: one run of a retrieval flow, the window it covered, where its files went and its outcome
docs.summary: One row per retrieve run: the kinds and query it read, its window (the next run's start), where it wrote its files, and what it wrote.

docs.title: osdu.Reversal: one reversal of a run or a submission, putting back what it put into OSDU
docs.summary: One row per run or submission reversed in a ledger: what it covers, its status, who asked and when, and the run that last worked on it.

docs.title: osdu.ReversalItem: each record a reversal reaches, what OSDU held before and what the reversal did
docs.summary: One row per record a reversed run or submission delivered: the versions it wrote, what OSDU held before, and the item's state and outcome.

docs.title: osdu.SchemaLineage: OSDU's lineage as one release of the OSDU data definitions declares it
docs.summary: One row per built release of the OSDU data definitions: its tag and commit, who built it and when, its kinds and relationships, and what failed.

docs.title: osdu.SchemaLineageKind: each kind of a built release, with the properties of its schema that refer to other records
docs.summary: One row per kind of a built OSDU release: its entity type, version and status, and every property of its schema that refers to other records.

docs.title: osdu.SchemaVersion: the single row that says which version of the osdu schema a database holds
docs.summary: The one row naming the osdu schema's module version, the last migration applied, when and by whom, and the oldest SQLFlow catalog migration it needs.

docs.title: osdu.SearchTerm: each search term a repository's pipelines give an entity type, written by every sync
docs.summary: One row per repository, term and entity type: a source column the active delivery flows read, with every route by which it reaches the records they render.

docs.title: osdu.SearchTermRefinement: what a person made of a search term, kept apart from what a sync writes
docs.summary: One row per search term a person refined: the name it is searched by, whether it is left out, the route it is searched through, a note, and who changed it.

docs.title: osdu.SourceWatermark: how far the last whole-scope plan of a flow scope read
docs.summary: One row per flow and scope (parameter set): the upper bound of the last completed whole-scope plan, the submission that wrote it, and its render context hash.

docs.title: osdu.Submission: one plan of a delivery flow over its ingestion tables, with its window and counts
docs.summary: One row per plan of a flow: what it read (window, full read or keys), what rendered it, its work batches, status and record counts.

docs.title: osdu.UpdateTag: each change to the cache that delivered records were built from, and its rollout
docs.summary: One row per cache change reaching delivered records: what changed, between which versions, whether it needs approval, its decision, and its rollout.

docs.title: osdu.WorkBatch: one file of rendered documents of a submission, claimed and drained as one unit
docs.summary: One row per work batch a submission's intake wrote: where its file is, how many records it holds, its status, the lease draining it, and its counts.

docs.title: Decision 0001: the delivery grain, one record per source log
docs.summary: Why a well log record is keyed by its source's own identity (project and log id) and not collapsed per wellbore.

docs.title: Decision 0002: deterministic, client-supplied OSDU ids
docs.summary: Why OSDU ids are computed from the data by the delivery instead of assigned by OSDU, and what that guarantees.

docs.title: Decision 0003: rendering runs in the delivery service
docs.summary: Why the mapping is interpreted by the delivery against a pinned template and cache version, not by a facade service.

docs.title: Decision 0004: Datasets, DDMSDatasets and ExtensionProperties belong to OSDU
docs.summary: Why an update keeps the properties a DDMS or External Data Services writes into a record, and leaves them out of the hash.

docs.title: Decision 0005: attempts are pruned by age, keeping the latest per record
docs.summary: Why the ledger's attempt history may be pruned by age while every record keeps its latest attempt.

docs.title: Decision 0006: rendered documents live in work batch files, not in the ledger
docs.summary: Why rendered documents are written to work batch files the ledger points at, and how large submissions fan out.

docs.title: Decision 0007: manifest datasets take ids derived from their record's id
docs.summary: Why the datasets a manifest delivery registers get ids derived from the record, so a redelivery can replace them.

docs.title: Decision 0008: retrieval lands records as OSDU holds them
docs.summary: Why a retrieval flow brings OSDU records back unchanged instead of reversing a mapping.

docs.title: Decision 0009: references to business data are searched for, not cached
docs.summary: Why wellbores and other business data are found by a search per record while closed vocabularies stay in the cache.

docs.title: Decision 0010: assertion flows read OSDU, check against templates, and keep whole reports
docs.summary: Why data quality tests read what OSDU serves, never write, and keep every report whole.

docs.title: Decision 0011: dimension flows read every distinct value by ranges and keep each key
docs.summary: Why dimensions page through every distinct value of a field by ranges instead of the search aggregation.

docs.title: Decision 0012: every delivery completes or is undone, and the ledger names every id it minted
docs.summary: Why a delivery of many OSDU calls is a unit of work whose minted ids the ledger keeps, so an unfinished one can be undone.

docs.title: Decision 0013: inventory flows compare what OSDU serves with every ledger of the partition
docs.summary: Why finding orphans needs a read of what OSDU serves set against every ledger, and what an inventory compares.

docs.title: Decision 0014: an inventory flow may remove the orphan, stale and forgotten ids it found
docs.summary: Why an inventory flow may remove what it found when its document allows it, and how that stays traceable.

docs.title: Decision 0015: a record OSDU lost is delivered again under its own id, and under a new one only when an operator asks
docs.summary: Why a record OSDU lost is delivered again under the id it claimed, restored first when soft-deleted, and given a new id only on request.

docs.title: Decision 0016: OSDU's relationships order a repository's waves, and dependencies between schedules are shown, not enforced
docs.summary: Why lineage orders delivery flows by the relationships OSDU's schemas declare, and why schedules that depend on each other are shown rather than chained.

docs.title: Decision 0017: A pipeline names the cache it needs current before it runs and the cache it updates after
docs.summary: Why the cache steps belong to the pipeline, why before is mandatory and after is not, why after reads storage, and how held records wait for what they miss.
keywords: update the cache before a pipeline
update the cache after a pipeline
held record waits for a reference

docs.title: Decision 0018: A repository's template folders hold the templates, and every reader reads the file
docs.summary: Why templates live only as files in template folders, how a document's template is settled, and why the database keeps an index and no copy.

docs.title: Decision 0019: A custom template is linked to its canonical kind, and its records read their parent from OSDU
docs.summary: Why a custom template names its canonical parent kind, why a record's parent is the same minted id, and why it is read from storage as it renders.

docs.title: Decision 0020: The explorer reads a partition through the partition's own connection, never a flow's
docs.summary: Why the explorer signs in with the platform and client a partition's configuration names, rather than borrowing a delivery flow's connection.

docs.title: Decision 0021: Records whose business keys OSDU already holds are adopted in a batch, and the next run takes them over
docs.summary: Why records whose ids OSDU already holds are adopted in a batch the next run carries out, and how linked instances share a record.

docs.title: Decision 0022: a removal flow reads the source's keys whole and keeps its deletions in the delivery ledger
docs.summary: Why records a source dropped are found by a flow kind of its own, read from the source, and kept as the delivery ledger's deletions, taken out once.

docs.title: Decision 0023: A canonical record links its children as it renders, once OSDU holds them, and a child landing plans it again
docs.summary: Why a canonical record links its custom children with $child, written in an open property, looked up as it renders, never held for them.

docs.title: Decision 0024: A scope parameter takes several values in one run, the set is its scope, and SQLFlow carries the list
docs.summary: Why a run value may be a list, carried by SQLFlow as JSON array text, why only a scope parameter takes one, and why the set is a scope of its own.

docs.title: Decision 0025: What runs at once is a flow's parallelism, and a delivery fans out by default
docs.summary: Why a delivery is spread over nodes by default, a part per node worked out from its rows, why its keys say what they are, and what was rejected.
keywords: parts on nodes of their own

docs.title: Decision 0026: The osdu schema lives in the catalog's database, reached through its one connection
docs.summary: Why the module has no database connection of its own, why a host ignores the retired SQLFLOW_OSDU_DB, and why the control plane owns the osdu schema.
keywords: osdu schema in the catalog database
control plane owns the osdu schema

docs.title: Decision 0027: an inventory finds the records OSDU holds more than once, keeps the most complete copy, and removes the rest through a selection
docs.summary: Why duplicates are found by downloading a key's properties and grouping them in SQL, why the fullest copy is kept, and how removal stays safe.

docs.title: Decision 0028: the sync moves a renamed flow's ledger when only the name changed, and a person takes over every other orphan
docs.summary: Why a pure rename's ledger follows its document's hash for every kind, why the sync makes the move once it committed, and why the rest is taken over by hand.

docs.title: Decision 0029: one Maintenance page accounts for the whole database, each part kept, safe to remove or optional
docs.summary: Why the osdu schema is described on SQLFlow's Maintenance page, why each area has one of three verdicts, and why nothing is removed until an admin sets a limit.

docs.title: Decision 0030: a dimension's rows are one range of every table, and a build's statements seek them
docs.summary: Why dimension tables are keyed on partition, dimension and row, why a write's statements force seeks, and why retrying or serialising writes was rejected.

docs.title: Decision 0031: a run shows and may change what its document declares, by one rule, and maxRecords is a default
docs.summary: Why every kind's run form lists the parameters its document declares, why one rule resolves them, why a lookup reads a column, and why maxRecords is a default.

docs.title: Decision 0032: a dimension build stages what it reads in the database and holds one batch in memory
docs.summary: Why a dimension build stages its reads in tables of the osdu schema, reads labels in bounded batches, and why more memory, temp tables and files were rejected.

docs.title: Pattern: a custom record beside its canonical record, linked both ways and supplementing each other
docs.summary: When OSDU's schema lacks what a source knows: a custom copy of the kind, linked to it, the two records reading and linking each other.

docs.title: Pattern catalog: which delivery problem maps to which OSDU Delivery shape
docs.summary: Problem-first index: where a lookup belongs, one kind or interfaces, which route, retrieval or explorer, tests, orphans, and the page for each.
